questions.stem: A 26-year female is to be operated on for a frontal lobe tumor. Her BP is 160/100 mmHg, pulse rate 58 /minute, and on fundoscopy papilledema is positive. All of the following statements are true regarding the anesthetic management of this patient except:

options.label: A
options.text: The patient can be hyperventilated to reduce ICT

options.label: B
options.text: The induction agent of choice is Thiopentone

options.label: C
options.text: The inhalational agent of choice is Sevoflurane

options.label: D
options.text: 5% dextrose is the fluid of choice for maintenance
